title: detectVerify resolves the verifier package-first with PATH as the fallback (FBS-217)
description: detectVerify tries resolveSelfBin (this package own bin/rcf.js, run under process.execPath) first, then resolvePackageBin from the project cwd, then findOnPath; each invocation carries source (package | path) and the resolved binary version. A foreign rcf first on PATH no longer wins over the package finalise runs from.
